[EN] We need elite warriors to carry out dangerous and difficult missions. How someone like Khurodan was chosen to come here, I cannot fathom. He only fights to save his own life in battle. He's a coward.
[ES] Necesitamos guerreros de élite para llevar a cabo misiones peligrosas y difíciles. No alcanzo a comprender cómo eligieron a alguien como Khurodan para venir aquí. Solo lucha para salvar su propia vida en el combate. Es un cobarde.
